kitDescription: Flora is an Electric MG Supporter whose value is almost entirely team-wide rather than personal damage. Her Skill 1 passively places a Peace of Mind aura on herself and her two neighbors that trickle-heals 1% of her max HP every second, grants stacking incoming-healing, and after 100 of her shots bumps stack counts on Electric allies; it also briefly raises those allies' max HP when she enters Burst Stage 2. Her Skill 2 is a defensive reactive layer: it shields the team when an adjacent ally falls below 90% HP, grants team True Damage when an adjacent ally returns to full HP, and grants a large caster-scaled ATK buff when a shield is placed in front of her. Her Burst II is her defining contribution: a team heal plus 10 seconds of True Damage ▲42.39% and a very large ATK buff equal to 85.86% of her own ATK for the whole squad.

verdictRationale: No REAL-GOTCHA exists: every one of the 10 kit lines is either faithfully modeled (4: burst casterAtkPct/trueDamagePct/heal + S1 HoT cadence) or deliberately unmodeled verbatim with a ⚑ engine-core/inert flag carrying estimate+recipe+tier (6: Incoming Healing, 100-hit stack bump, S1 Max-HP grant, all of S2). The whole-S2 drop is NOT silent — v1 has no HP pool and the boss deals no damage, so the HP-threshold/max-HP/shield-chain triggers genuinely never fire; this matches the liter cover-HP and alliesLowestHp precedents, and the driver prices the loss ('sim under-represents Flora') rather than fudging uptime — DOCUMENTED_GAP, not NO-GO(engine-core). On the two contested points the driver is strictly better than the blinds: (a) interval:1 HoT models 'every 1 sec continuously' where S6's passive+ticks:1 fires once and S5 skipped outright (F4 proves ~1s cadence); (b) the burst ATK ▲85.86%-of-caster line — Flora's defining contribution, routed exactly per the SSOT caster-flat-ATK rule — was omitted by ALL THREE blind roles; the driver models and discriminately pins it (F1 casterAtkPct-vs-atkPct + liveness). Convergence note: the S5 run is RED at compile level only (ov.burst.blocks vs bare-array schema — a blind harness artifact), with all substantive assertions green in substance; I classify that RECON_ERROR-adjacent, not a driver finding. Discrimination holds on all four pins (F1 scaling contrast, F2 flavor byte-identity, F3/F4 cadence collapse).
